name: labs/itdaniher__olin-smus
title: Olin ModCon USB source-measure unit
intro: Olin ModCon USB source-measure unit, adapted from itdaniher/olin-smus. It reads `measured_voltage`, `measured_current`, `mod_voltage` and `source_mode`; sets `source_voltage` and `source_current`; runs `source_off`. `source_off`: set the source current target to zero with the upstream set(amps=0) safety call; it takes no input and is the declared safe state. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/itdaniher__olin-smus --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/itdaniher__olin-smus --backend fake --mcp
